profile.headline: Software Engineer at CareEvolution, Inc
profile.summary:
My primary goal is to improve health and wellness through technology. I also like to build interesting things.

I have enjoyed exploring and iterating on clinical decision support, pharmacy informatics, clinical pharmacy, pharmacokinetics, data analysis, data simulation, health research, and machine learning.

I have some experience expressing ideas through Mac/iOS - Swift/Objective C; other languages - [M]UMPS, Python, Bash, SQL, VBA, JavaScript, HTML/CSS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I work on interesting problems with fascinating people in health care and health information technology.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: Developed, designed and provide tech support for the Universal iOS App iQIF and iPhone App StattyCaddy, both currently available on the iOS App Store.  Fluent in Swift, Objective C (frameworks: UIKit, AppKit).

positions.title: Clinical Informatics Pharmacist / Developer
positions.description:
Guided and directed the use of medications in the electronic medical record with a goal of improving medication use thru technology.  Also assisted in development of unique solutions thru application development/enhancement.  

Fluent in Caché/M[UMPS] and have written library code to improve Willow functionality in our Epic deployment including enhanced functionality of VCG groupers and the scoring tool, and a AIF-based override system of Therapeutic class for all medications to allow better classifications without interfering with data vendor-imported data.

positions.title: Clinical Pharmacist
positions.locationName: Theda Clark Medical Center - Neenah, WI
positions.description: I guided application support for Epic at ThedaCare with an emphasis on improving medication use throughout our organization as well as overall workflow optimization throughout our 5 affiliated hospitals live on CPOE.

company.name: City of Menasha Parks & Recreation Department

positions.title: Summer Recreation Supervisor
positions.description: Coordinated summer recreation activities and lead a staff of 15 season staff members.

positions.title: Tennis Instructor
positions.description: Provided tennis instruction for children and adults as well as assisted in city tournament coordination and other summer recreation activities. I really miss this job. I'm also impressed you read this far down my profile :)
